description: The bundled entries added to the library once, on first start, with no download (home-and-examples 5.1, D-111). Each has a 'group': 'example' (teaching material) or 'reference' (a published vocabulary to build on, reference-ontologies 5.2), which decides its chip; on Home they follow the person's own work, the examples first and then the references, each group in this order. Each file is the application's own and is pinned by SHA-256; test_library_examples.py fails on a mismatch. 'file' is relative to backend/app; FOAF and QUDT are the bundled vocabularies themselves (vocab/), not copies. Change a file and its hash together: a changed hash is what replaces an example already in a library. Each example's 'questions' are ready-made SPARQL files in examples/questions/ (query-page-rework 5.4), pinned the same way and shown first in Query's Try one of these; a question file opens with a one-line comment saying what it shows. A reference's 'reuse' is what New project offers and the Edit pickers read (reference-ontologies 8, D-121): 'title' names its terms (Organization, from FOAF), 'ontology' is the IRI dcterms:requires names, 'prefixes' the namespaces its classes and properties are defined in, 'purpose' the checkbox's line and 'sentence' the description's. A third reference is an entry like these, its bundled file and a NOTICE row.
